author.016.en: BaziMaster writes the guides on this site and built the engine behind it. The engine turns a birth moment into a BaZi chart with the traditional solar calendar and true-solar time, reads a traced floor plan into flying-star and Eight House (
author.016.zh: BaziMaster 撰写本站的指南，也搭建了背后的引擎。引擎依传统节气历和真太阳时，把一个出生时刻排成八字命盘；把描摹好的户型图读成飞星与八宅

author.017.en: ) maps, and scores Chinese baby names by useful element (

author.020.en: ), meaning and sound. Every line of output names the classical rule it applies, so a reader, or a practitioner, can check it.
author.020.zh: 、字义与读音给中文名字打分。输出的每一行都注明所依据的古法规则，读者或专业人士都能核对。

author.021.en: The method is deterministic on purpose. The same birth data always gives the same chart; the same floor plan always gives the same stars. Where schools disagree, for example on a character's element or a stroke count, the engine records the choice it made and marks it as disputed rather than hiding it. The flying-star work was checked against a paid professional audit of a real home and matched it star for star.
author.021.zh: 这套方法是有意做成确定的。同样的出生数据总是排出同样的命盘，同样的户型图总是得出同样的飞星。各流派有分歧时，比如某个字的五行归属或笔画数，引擎会记下自己的取舍，并标注为有争议，而不是藏起来。飞星部分曾与一份真实住宅的付费专业风水评估报告对照，逐颗星相符。

author.022.en: What this site does not claim

author.023.en: It does not predict events. It computes classical structures and states the traditional reading of them.
author.023.zh: 不预测事件。只推算经典结构，并给出它们的传统解读。

author.024.en: It does not replace a practitioner for decisions with real consequences; it gives you the working to bring to one.
author.024.zh: 不能代替专业人士做有实际后果的决定；它给你的是可以带去请教专业人士的推算依据。

author.025.en: It does not use generative AI for any reading. The text you see is rule output and hand-written guides.
author.025.zh: 不用生成式 AI 写任何解读。你看到的文字是规则输出和人工撰写的指南。
